title: Communication in the Presence of Noise (Shannon, 1949)
excerpt: Theorem 1: If a function f(t) contains no frequencies higher than W cps, it is completely determined by giving its ordinates at a series of points spaced 1/2W seconds apart.
focus: Explain sampling and aliasing: a sinusoid of frequency f sampled at rate fs. Let the learner change f and fs. Show the continuous signal, the sample points, and the lowest-frequency sinusoid through the samples (the alias). Check that when fs > 2f the reconstructed frequency equals f, and when fs < 2f the apparent frequency is |f - k fs|. Explain the Nyquist rate 2W.
